name: graph-first-gate
description: DeepSeek Harness flavour of the same hard gate the pi adapter enforces. v3 shares the engine fixes: the cap no longer disables safety checks, shell writes are covered, the bash reader understands cd/git/find/xargs/recursive greps, destructive commands are denied, and empty graph results no longer count. dsh has no result hook and no per-turn context injection, so graph_signal_requires_content stays off and the Layer-0 checks that need result/read evidence (think-before-write, no-blind-retry) are not enabled here. bash reads are now actually gated (v2 listed the check but the adapter never passed bash events).
